constraint.display: Unique name required for each instance
Physical input must match channel and edge (falling channel 0 wraps to input 2)
Falling stereo requires a rising source with matched sinc mode, decimation/range and FIFO threshold
PDMIF bus clock PCLKB must be 1 to 62.5 MHz
Name must be a valid C symbol

property.description: Assign the entire PDMIF peripheral, shared clock and interrupts exclusively to one core. All instances and IRQ handlers run on that core; serialize API calls except documented callback-safe calls. Duplicate processing channels are rejected within this project only. Open's local IRQ-context/channel checks detect sequential duplicates, not atomic reservations; no cross-core synchronization is provided.

constraint.display: Pins|Physical Input Channel: integer 0 to 2 required

property.description: Falling stereo uses physical input CH(n-1), wrapping CH0 to CH2 (HM50.2.19). Add the source instance in rising mode with matching sinc order, decimation/range and FIFO threshold. Open the source first; stop/close the falling consumer first. The source supplies the clock; the falling channel's CKDIV is unused. Shifts, word format and coefficients may differ.

property.display: Filter|Sinc Order (HM table 50.7 decimation and clipping)

constraint.display: Clock|Additional Microphone Settling Time (us): integer 0 to 1000000 required

property.description: NULL uses HM reset coefficients; otherwise name a const pdm_coefficients_t.

constraint.display: Coefficient structure must be a C symbol
Errors|Short Circuit Low Limit: integer 0 to 8191 required
Errors|Short Circuit High Limit: integer 0 to 8191 required
Errors|Lower Limit (raw signed 20-bit): integer 0 to 1048575 required
Errors|Upper Limit (raw signed 20-bit): integer 0 to 1048575 required
Callback must be a valid C symbol
